Pima Regional Trail
System Master Plan
December 2010

OVERVIEW
Plan is an update of the 1989 and 1996 Eastern Pima
County Trails System Master Plan(s) with an emphasis on
identifying facility opportunities in Tucson’s urban core
area and connections from the core to the surrounding
trail system.
